method.comparison: For each complete observed B1/B2/T triplet, sort its three numeric frequencies ascending and subtract that triplet from the independent continuous model first three ascending frequencies, rank by rank.
method.critical_assumption: The three frequencies reported as B1/B2/T are assumed to be the lowest three modes of this reduced bending-torsion model. This assumption is not established by frequency data alone and may fail when modes are missing, labels are ambiguous, or reduced-model kinematics omit physical modes.
method.scenarios: Both physical icc endpoints, each at rho=0 and rho=1.225 kg/m^3; all four are reported without selecting an endpoint or density by fit.
method.air_model: The rho=1.225 predictions are an independent thin-strip added-mass diagnostic, not OpenSwing aerodynamics and not a recovered experimental density.
method.experiment_medium: Every zero-speed observation prints 0% Freon-12, meaning air; its density is unreported. Flutter-row mixture or density is not substituted.
method.outlier_threshold: Absolute relative residual >10% is a transparent descriptive flag only, not a calibrated acceptance threshold or uncertainty test.
method.summary_weighting: Each individual complete triplet contributes three residuals for each scenario. Repeated before/after observations and unloaded controls remain separate and therefore receive separate weight. Case summaries expose this replication.
method.source_ordering: B1/B2/T are printed physical labels, not ascending-rank labels. A T below B2 is not by itself a source error. Source order is preserved separately; rank changes between repeated observations are reported without relabeling physical modes.
method.uncertainty: Reported digit precision and before/after changes are not calibrated confidence intervals. Original cell confidence/status and six Not clear cells are preserved; incomplete triplets are excluded without filling missing cells.

limitations: These native calculations omit still-air inertia; vacuum and test conditions differ.
Sorted measured B1/B2/T triplets are compared with the computed lowest three modes. Physical mode identity is not inferred from closest measured frequencies.
The bounds on one distributed inertia component do not bound all unknown fixture, pylon and section properties.
Before/after readings, moderate-confidence cells and unreadable cells are retained separately. No measured frequencies are averaged or used to fit inputs.
Higher-mode numerical mixing and two nonmonotonic refinement sequences remain recorded in the numerical audit.
